text:
### 5. Unauthorized Account Access (Account Takeover)  
**Example:** Customer discovers account used without permission  
**Investigation:**
- Immediate account freeze
- Transaction review
- Authentication review (password change?)
- Fraud team escalation
- Law enforcement notification (if warranted)  
**Resolution:**
- Full reimbursement of fraudulent transactions
- Account security reset
- Replacement card/online access reset
- Credit monitoring (if identity theft)
- Regular follow-up

raw_entities.name: Unauthorized Account Access Policy
raw_entities.description: Policy governing the response, investigation, and resolution of unauthorized account access and account takeover scenarios. It defines the mandatory steps for mitigating fraud and restoring customer security.
context: Customer discovers account used without permission

raw_entities.name: Unauthorized Account Access
raw_entities.description: The risk of a customer account being accessed and used without the owner's permission, categorized as account takeover.
context: Customer discovers account used without permission

raw_entities.name: Immediate Account Freezing for Unauthorized Access
raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement to immediately freeze a customer account upon the discovery of unauthorized access as part of the investigation process.

raw_entities.name: Investigation of Transactions and Authentication
raw_entities.description: Requirement to perform a comprehensive review of transactions and authentication methods, including verifying if password changes occurred, following a takeover event.

raw_entities.name: Fraud Team Escalation and Law Enforcement Notification
raw_entities.description: Obligation to escalate the incident to the fraud team and, where warranted, notify law enforcement agencies.

raw_entities.name: Full Reimbursement of Fraudulent Transactions
raw_entities.description: The bank's obligation to provide full reimbursement to the customer for transactions identified as fraudulent resulting from unauthorized access.

raw_entities.name: Account Security and Access Reset
raw_entities.description: Requirement to reset account security and provide replacement cards or reset online access credentials following a breach.

raw_entities.name: Provision of Credit Monitoring for Identity Theft
raw_entities.description: Obligation to provide credit monitoring services to the customer specifically in cases where the account takeover involved identity theft.

raw_entities.name: Account Freeze Mechanism
raw_entities.description: Operational safeguard used to immediately prevent further unauthorized activity on a compromised account.

raw_entities.name: Authentication Review
raw_entities.description: Review process to determine if authentication credentials were compromised or changed during an account takeover.

raw_entities.name: Fraud Team
raw_entities.description: The internal collective responsible for handling escalated fraud cases and managing the investigation of unauthorized account access.

raw_entities.name: Law Enforcement
raw_entities.description: External authorities to be notified when unauthorized account access warrants legal or criminal investigation.

raw_entities.name: Affected Customer
raw_entities.description: The bank customer who has experienced unauthorized account access and is the subject of reimbursement and security resets.
context: Customer discovers account used without permission

raw_entities.name: Compromised Account
raw_entities.description: The customer account subject to unauthorized access and subsequent freezing and security resets.

raw_entities.name: Fraudulent Transaction
raw_entities.description: Transactions occurring without the customer's permission that are subject to review and reimbursement.

raw_entities.name: Replacement Card
raw_entities.description: The process of issuing a new payment card to a customer following a fraudulent account takeover.
